article.headline: Shumate scores 22, buries 7 3-pointers and No. 24 Michigan State women rout Indiana State 115-66
article.description: — Emma Shumate scored 22 points, leading seven in double figures, and No. 24 Michigan State routed Indiana State 115-66 on Sunday at the Cherokee Invitational.
article.linkText: Shumate scores 22, buries 7 3-pointers and No. 24 Michigan State women rout Indiana State 115-66

event.description: Indiana State Sycamores @ Michigan State Spartans

keywords: Indiana State Sycamores @ Michigan State Spartans
article.story: CHEROKEE, N.C. -- — Emma Shumate scored 22 points, leading seven in double figures, and No. 24 Michigan State routed Indiana State 115-66 on Sunday at the Cherokee Invitational. Shumate matched her career high in points and made a career-high seven 3-pointers. Kennedy Blair had 11 points and 10 rebounds. She came up a little shy of a triple-double, dishing out seven assists. Isaline Alexander scored 15 points, Sara Sambolic 14, Jalyn Brown 13, Grace VanSlooten 12 and Rashunda Jones 10 for Michigan State (10-1). Jayci Allen scored 13 and Kennedy Claybrooks 10 for the Sycamores (4-6). VanSlooten scored all of her 12 points in the first quarter, all of them in a row as the Spartans turned a 3-2 lead into a 15-6 advantage. Michigan State scored the last nine points of the quarter and led 34-15 heading to the second. They were outscored 28-25 in the second quarter but led 59-43 at the half. The Spartans scored the first 11 points of the third quarter on the way to a 28-11 advantage for the period. Six 3-pointers, four of them by Shumate, highlighted the fourth quarter. Michigan State is 5-0 all-time against Indiana State. Up next On Monday's day two of the event, Michigan State will play No. 14 Mississippi for the championship and Indiana State will play Old Dominion. ------ Get poll alerts and updates on the AP Top 25 throughout the season.
